name: Traumerai no Haka
source:
Tsutsuji and Sumire meet at an unpopular subway station. For some reason, the train never seems to stop. Together, they search for clues to escape.

[from https://graveoftraumerei.carrd.co/]
translation:
踯躅与堇在一座冷清的地铁站里相遇。不知为何，驶过的列车似乎永远也不会停靠。两人决定携手寻找逃离此地的线索。

[摘自graveoftraumerei.carrd.co]
